body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adapts Conditional Formatting to support both the Spec `{ condition, style }` format and the ObjectUI `{ field, operator, value, ... }` format across types, validation, evaluation, and ListView rendering.

**Changes:**
- Added dual-format ConditionalFormatting union types in `@object-ui/types` and exported them.
- Updated ListView conditional formatting evaluation to support plain expressions (e.g. `status == 'overdue'`) via `evaluatePlainCondition`.
- Added/updated unit tests covering Spec/ObjectUI interop and plain/template expression evaluation; updated roadmap entry.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts | Updates ListViewSchema Zod validation to accept both Spec and ObjectUI conditionalFormatting shapes. |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Introduces ConditionalFormattingRule union types and applies them to ListView/ObjectGrid schemas. |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Exports the new ConditionalFormatting types. |
| packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts | Adds `evaluatePlainCondition()` helper for evaluating both template and plain conditions with record context. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Refactors conditional formatting evaluation to use `evaluatePlainCondition` and union narrowing. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ConditionalFormatting.test.ts | Adds Spec-format and mixed-format tests for conditional formatting behavior. |
| packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/ExpressionEvaluator.test.ts | Adds tests for `evaluatePlainCondition`. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents completion details for conditional formatting protocol reconciliation. |
</details>

In the spec-rule branch, the Zod object only defines { condition, style }. Because Zod objects strip unknown keys by default, any additional overrides like backgroundColor/textColor/borderColor (which ListView’s evaluator supports and tests cover) will be silently dropped during schema validation. If you want those overrides to work, add those optional keys to this branch or mark the object as .passthrough() so validation doesn’t remove them.
```suggestion
    }).passthrough(),
```

ObjectGridSchema is now typed to support ConditionalFormattingRule[], but the Zod ObjectGridSchema validator currently does not include a conditionalFormatting field at all. Any validated/parsed object-grid schema will have conditionalFormatting stripped, effectively disabling the feature at runtime for validated schemas. Please update the ObjectGridSchema Zod definition to include conditionalFormatting with the same dual-format union (or otherwise ensure validation preserves this field).
